summary: Create Record (BYOB): inserts a record into a self-hosted backend class, returning the new record and its id.
description: The bring-your-own-backend Create Record posts a new record with the property values on its schema-generated inputs when `create` fires. `success` delivers `record` (the created object) and `recordId`; `failure` delivers a structured `error`. `loading` is a boolean level for progress UI. Unlike the classic cloud-data family, BYOB results do not live-update — pair writes with an explicit re-fetch of any Query Data feeding the UI.
whenToUse: Creating records against a self-hosted/BYOB backend. On the managed cloud backend use Create New Record (NewDbModelProperties) instead.

ports.recordId: The new record's id — hand it to Update/Delete Record or store it for navigation.
ports.loading: Boolean level, true while the request is in flight.

runtimeBehavior: Class choice and per-property inputs are generated from the backend schema (runtime-discovered); the static surface is only the trigger and result ports.
patterns: `success` → the list query's `fetch`: BYOB writes refresh reads explicitly.
